## Data study: VPS price per GB RAM / per vCPU
Across 28 verified VPS plans from 12 providers (checked through 2026-10-31), list price per GB of RAM ranges from $1.21/GB/mo (OVHcloud VPS-3) to $10.00/GB/mo (AWS Lightsail Linux 0.5 GB) — 8.3× apart; the median is $5.00/GB. Hetzner CX23 and Hetzner CX33 would rank lower per GB but are sold out as of 2026-10-31, so they are left out of these figures. Per vCPU, OVHcloud VPS-3 is cheapest at $2.42/vCPU/mo vs a $6.50 median. Intro prices hide renewal jumps of up to +85% (Hostinger VPS KVM 1).
- Page: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/study/vps-price-per-gb-ram
- CSV: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/api/study-vps-price-per-gb.csv

## Changes
- 2026-10-31 UpCloud (correction): Correction: the $3.50 UpCloud row was labeled “Developer 1 GB”, a plan UpCloud now lists as discontinued. Renamed to the orderable Starter 1 GB ($3.50, 250 Mbit/s, max 5 per customer), Premium 1 GB ($6) verified and Starter 4 GB / 2 vCPU ($14) added, all re-read from UpCloud’s global pricing page. UpCloud Simple Backup (+20%) is now counted when backups are on. Discontinued plans are never ranked or suggested. [https://upcloud.com/global/pricing/]
- 2026-10-31 Vultr (correction): Correction: our verdicts, rankings and savings figures left out Vultr’s published 20% backup fee while the tables on the same pages included it. Vultr vc2-2c-4gb was shown as $20.00/mo “with backups” (and $106/yr cheaper than DigitalOcean); the true cost is $24.00/mo and the gap is $57.60/yr. Affected 19 pages. One fee policy now applies everywhere (every fee we hold is counted in tables, verdicts, rankings, widget and calculator), Vultr backup (20%) and overage ($0.01/GB) and Hetzner backup (20%) are now verified from official docs, and a build check fails if any verdict price differs from its own table. [https://docs.vultr.com/support/platform/billing/how-much-does-it-cost-to-enable-automatic-backups]
- 2026-10-31 Hetzner (availability): Re-checked: all 8 Cost-Optimized plans (CX23, CX33, CX43, CX53, CAX11, CAX21, CAX31, CAX41) are marked “not available” (“This product is currently unavailable. Please check back later.”). Cost-Optimized is listed for eu-central NBG1/HEL1 only. [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-31 Hetzner (correction): Correction: VPSLedger’s “Are you overpaying?” check, calculator and guides had suggested switching to Hetzner CX23/CX33 although Hetzner lists them as unavailable since our 2026-10-26 check. They are now labeled “Sold out” and “EU only” and are no longer suggested as switch targets; savings figures were recomputed from orderable plans only. [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-31 Hostinger VPS (correction): Correction to the Black Friday VPS guide: it bolded Hostinger as lowest for each RAM size but compared it only with Vultr and DigitalOcean, leaving out cheaper no-prepay plans in our own ledger. OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment, re-read 2026-10-31) costs $64.20 / $128.40 / $192.60 over 1/2/3 years vs Hostinger KVM 1 $155.76 / $155.76 / $443.52, and OVHcloud VPS-2 (4 vCPU / 8 GB, $10/mo) is lower than KVM 2 at 1 and 3 years. The guide now adds the cheapest verified, in-stock, no-prepay plan per RAM size and a build check fails if a 'lowest' label skips a cheaper row. The 3-year column assumed a 12-month renewal Hostinger doesn't show (KVM 1 $299.64); it now uses the stated same-term renewal (24 months billed up front at month 25): KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52. Sale window Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026 added from Hostinger's Black Friday page. [https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting]

## Black Friday VPS deals 2026: renewal math (checked 2026-10-31)
Page: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/guides/black-friday-vps-deals-2026
The Black Friday price is not what you pay at renewal. 5 vendors show a price on their own page today (RackNerd, Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost). Only RackNerd says its plans renew at the same price; its 4 GB KVM VPS special is the lowest 3-year cash for 4 GB in our table ($179.97). Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost renew higher. As of 2026-10-31, Hostinger's VPS sale (runs Oct 19 – Dec 14, 2026) lists KVM 2 (2 vCPU / 8 GB) at $8.79/mo, but only on a 24-month prepay ($210.96 today). It renews at $14.99/mo (+71%) for the same 24-month term, billed up front again ($359.76), so keeping it past 2 years costs $570.72 in cash by month 25. If you can’t prepay 24 months: OVHcloud VPS-1 (2 vCPU / 4 GB, $5.35/mo, no commitment) costs less than Hostinger KVM 1 at 1, 2 and 3 years ($192.60 vs $443.52 over 3 years).

- Q: What is the best Black Friday VPS deal in 2026?
  A: We only list deals we read on the vendor's own page. As of 2026-10-31: RackNerd from $21.99 for 12 months (1 GB KVM VPS special, renews at the same price); Hostinger from $155.76 for 24 months (KVM 1, renews $11.99/mo); AwakeHost from $17.49 for the first month (Cloud VPS 4, renews $24.99/mo); ScalaHosting from $269.52 for 12 months (Managed Cloud Build #1 (1-year term), renews $54.95/mo); Bluehost from $227.76 for 24 months (Self-Managed NVMe 4, renews $11.99/mo). Cheapest 3-year cash per RAM size: 4 GB RackNerd 4 GB KVM VPS special $179.97, 8 GB RackNerd 8 GB KVM VPS special $359.97, 16 GB Hostinger KVM 4 $1,007.52, 32 GB Hostinger KVM 8 $1,823.52. Devoster announced prices that start later (runs Nov 20 – Dec 2, 2026 (UTC), code BF2026); listed separately, not counted as lowest.
- Q: Which Black Friday VPS deals renew at the same price?
  A: RackNerd: “Yes. These RackNerd VPS specials are lifetime recurring. You can renew at the same rate for as long as you decide to keep the service.” Hostinger, AwakeHost, ScalaHosting, Bluehost renew at a higher regular price (quotes in the table). netcup says promo prices stay the same at renewal, but has no Black Friday VPS price yet.

  A: KVM 1: $6.49/mo now, renews at $11.99/mo (+85%); KVM 2: $8.79/mo now, renews at $14.99/mo (+71%); KVM 4: $12.99/mo now, renews at $28.99/mo (+123%); KVM 8: $25.99/mo now, renews at $49.99/mo (+92%). Cash by month 25: KVM 1 $443.52, KVM 2 $570.72, KVM 4 $1,007.52, KVM 8 $1,823.52.
- Q: When does the Hostinger Black Friday sale end?
  A: Hostinger's Black Friday page says: "The Hostinger Black Friday sale runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026." (read 2026-10-31). Prices can change during the sale; re-check before you pay.
- Q: Do I have to prepay to get the Black Friday VPS price?
  A: It depends on the vendor: RackNerd 12 months up front; Hostinger 24 months up front; AwakeHost 1 month (billed monthly) up front; ScalaHosting 12 months or 36 months up front; Bluehost 24 months up front. Hostinger's page says "All plans are paid upfront". OVHcloud, Vultr and DigitalOcean plans in our table bill monthly with no prepay.
